```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const ready = (fn) =>
    document.readyState !== "loading"
      ? fn()
      : document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);

  ready(function () {
    const list = document.getElementById("pub-list");
    if (!list) return;

    const search  = document.getElementById("pub-search");
    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".pub-filters button");
    const counter = document.getElementById("pub-count");
    const pubs    = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll(".pub"));

    // Emphasise Zach's name in each author string.
    list.querySelectorAll(".pub-authors").forEach((el) => {
      el.innerHTML = el.textContent.replace(
        /Swiecki, Z\./g,
        '<span class="me">Swiecki, Z.</span>'
      );
    });
    const heads   = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll(".pub-year"));
    const nodes   = Array.from(list.children);

    let activeType = "all";

    function apply() {
      const q = (search.value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      let shown = 0;

      pubs.forEach((p) => {
        const okType = activeType === "all" || p.dataset.type === activeType;
        const okText = !q || (p.dataset.search || "").includes(q);
        const visible = okType && okText;
        p.hidden = !visible;
        if (visible) shown++;
      });

      // Hide a year heading when nothing under it survived the filter.
      heads.forEach((h) => {
        let n = nodes.indexOf(h) + 1;
        let any = false;
        while (n < nodes.length && !nodes[n].classList.contains("pub-year")) {
          if (!nodes[n].hidden) { any = true; break; }
          n++;
        }
        h.hidden = !any;
      });

      counter.textContent =
        shown + (shown === 1 ? " publication" : " publications");
    }

    search.addEventListener("input", apply);

    buttons.forEach((b) => {
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        buttons.forEach((x) => x.classList.remove("active"));
        b.classList.add("active");
        activeType = b.dataset.filter;
        apply();
      });
    });

    apply();
  });
})();
</script>
```
